finalText:
Build's clean now, exit 0. The real error was in `src/core/settings.js`: `resolveConfig` referenced an undefined variable `retries` instead of `env.retries`, and there was no fallback constant defined. I added `maxRetries: 3` to the defaults and fixed the line to `env.retries || DEFAULTS.maxRetries`.

Everything else was noise — three harmless warnings (a deprecated crypto call, an unused export, a circular import) that were never the actual blocker. Build now finishes with those same 3 warnings but 0 errors.
